title: Complete implementation
adaptationNote: The unchanged shared course_test.hpp from Book II B02-L0110 is placed first; the local include is removed. CHECK stays active in optimized builds.

guide.problem: Search ordered nodes while allowing updates.
guide.design: A binary search tree narrows a search by key. A sorted vector is simpler for mostly-read data and can be cache-friendly.
guide.invariant: All keys on the left are smaller and all on the right larger under the duplicate policy.
guide.failure: Deleting a two-child node without reconnecting its successor loses ordering or a subtree.
guide.trace: After deleting 5 from keys 3,5,7, inorder must still produce 3,7.
guide.maintenance: Verify ordering after every update, not only whether one search succeeded.
guide.scope: This panel connects this listing to its chapter’s problem. Short demonstrations illustrate one part; the chapter’s complete implementation and invariant labs test the broader contract.

experiment: Predict one boundary or tie case, then change this listing and trace the affected state. After deleting 5 from keys 3,5,7, inorder must still produce 3,7.

checks.label: Original behavior
checks.hint: Compare the first changed output, assertion, or process exit. Preserve the stated invariant before changing the expected result.
